info.name: BookingEngineApi Account notes Payment requests API

items.docs:
Get all payment requests belonging to the specified customer accounts. 
Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

Creates a payment request to the specified [Customer](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/customers/#customer). Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
Cancels specified payment requests. Only payment requests which are in `Pending` state can be canceled.
